features: NO DATABASE CHANGES — Succession the way practices handle it, first part. In a succession and in a legacy the settlement is no longer proposed as a given: you choose whether to write it, with nothing pre-selected, and the «What will change» panel shows both paths before the choice. The sentences of the succession, of the history and of the balances were rewritten where they said false things or put «a» before a name starting with «a» (Italian «ad»).

CHANGED: IN A SUCCESSION AND IN A LEGACY THE SETTLEMENT IS CHOSEN — With the arrears in the deceased's name and a settlement to propose, the panel asks «Write the settlement» or «Don't write it: the position stays as it is», with neither pre-selected; without the choice the transfer is not recorded. «Don't write it» writes no balance rows and does not ask you to declare an agreement: the note is optional. The issued instalments stay with the deceased, and the draft instalments listed in the panel pass to the reference heir, who pays them all. With the arrears to the heirs there is no choice. Since beta.44 the succession had the box «The heirs settled between themselves», with a mandatory note; sale, usufruct and lease keep the box «The parties settled between themselves».

CHANGED: BEFORE THE CHOICE THE PANEL SHOWS BOTH PATHS — The badge says «settlement to choose»; what stays in the deceased's name is given with both figures («€ 400.00 without the settlement, € 394.52 if you write the settlement»), in the gate too; the opening sentence is conditional. The per-share calculation sentences show before the choice and with «Write», and disappear with «Don't write it». Before, the panel always showed the outcome of «Write», because the waiver box started unticked.

CHANGED: THE HISTORY SAYS «SETTLEMENT NOT WRITTEN» — On every row of the transfer, appurtenances included; the message after recording says «No balance rows». With the settlement written, as long as it can still be cancelled, the record also gives the path for when it should not have been written: cancel the transfer and record it again with «Don't write it».

CHANGED: EACH HEIR'S FIGURE, NOT THEIR SUM — Where the settlement is not written, or was cancelled, the sentence of the plan that is no longer recalculated and the warning when cancelling the transfer give each person's figure («€ 531.45 credit to Anna, € 268.47 debit to Bruno and € 268.46 debit to Carla»), not «€ 5.48», a sum of figures with different signs. For successions with several heirs recorded before this beta the individual figures were not kept, and the message says so. A plan held still by a succession whose settlement is not written «is held still» by that transfer, not «taken into the settlement».

CHANGED: THE LEGACY DOES NOT CALL THOSE WHO RECEIVE THE UNIT «HEIRS» — In the panel sentences, in the choice options, in the box and in the refusal that ask who receives the draft instalments, in the form and in the messages.

CHANGED: IN THE SUCCESSION OF THE BARE OWNER THE ORDINARY SHARE FOLLOWS THE ITEM — The panel always said «the ordinary share stays with the usufructuary»; with an ordinary item on «Owner» the plan instead charged it to the bare owner, and the settlement splits it among the heirs. Now the sentence says so, and says that the law (art. 1004 of the Italian Civil Code) would give the ordinary share to the usufructuary: for future plans you follow it by moving the item to «Usufructuary». No new choice.

FIXES — In a transfer with someone leaving, a date that is not a date gave an error page; in a succession the messages speak of the day of death, not of the date of the deed. Hand-built requests: the choice outside a succession or together with the box is refused; a list instead of the type, the form, the role or the arrears gives the field's message; an heir given as «true» made person record number 1 an heir, even from another condominium, and heirs sent as a map recorded the succession without a settlement: now they are refused. «ad» before names starting with «a» in all succession sentences, and in every transfer in the gate sentences on the leaving person's shares. The other heirs' balance rows enter «the next plan of the same management», not «the plan after». When the panel only waits for the reference heir it says «A choice is missing in the form», not «A field of the form is not acceptable». The heirs' credit figures are written «€ 531.45 credit», not «€ -531.45». The balance messages no longer say «one of the two rows». The reference-heir box says what happens with and without the settlement.

THE GUIDES — The transfer guide says that the settlement is chosen, what the two options do, how to correct, and what happens to the ordinary share when the bare owner dies. The balances guide and the instalment plan guide say the settlement rows are one pair for each person who enters; the balances guide also says that in a sale and a succession the drafts of a plan that is no longer recalculated pass to whoever enters (it said they stayed with whoever leaves), and the plan guide the plan held still by a succession whose settlement is not written.

NOT YET — Drafts split among the heirs by share, as a choice; the reference heir in the following years; the settlement made later, when the heirs ask for it, which today is written by hand with a manual balance from the Wallet.

FOR DEVELOPERS — No migration: the choice lives in registro.conguaglio.scelta (scritto / non_scritto). The request field conguaglio (scrivi / non_scrivere). Subentro::conguaglioNonScritto(), regolato_fuori.persone. In the preview rate.arretrato.frase_da_scegliere and rate.frasi_del_conguaglio. FrasiObbligati::conLaD(), PianoRate::passaggiNonScritti(). AnteprimaPassaggioRequest: list for eredi, numeric for the heir id. Front end preposizione.ts (aNome), fraseArretrato(…, daScegliere). New tests: SuccessioneSceltaConguaglioTest, SuccessioneTestiTest, SuccessionePannelloTest, SuccessioneRichiestaTest, SuccessioneGiroStrettoTest, AnteprimaPassaggio.test.ts, preposizione.test.ts.
